findings.title: Evaluate only the selected if branch
findings.contract: expression-check.ts:203: if(condition, a, b), equivalent to condition ? a : b.
findings.problem: Every argument is evaluated at line 982 before branch selection. At frame 0, if(frame < 10, 1, valueAtTime(10000)) validates but throws comp-evaluation-time; equivalent ternary returns 1.
findings.fix: Dispatch if before eager argument evaluation, evaluate condition and only the selected branch.

findings.title: Require matching vector dimensions for distance arguments
findings.contract: docs/composition-reference.md:766-767 distinguishes vec2 and vec3 and states there is no implicit conversion; built-in registry promises distance between two points.
findings.problem: Two length arguments independently accept either vector type. length([0,0],[0,0,10]) validates and returns 0; reversing arguments validates but throws comp-expression-value.

findings.title: Preserve auto-orient boundary samples when baking
findings.contract: docs/composition-reference.md:851-852: The result evaluates identically at every integer frame; :863-864: auto-orient reads the baked position identically.
findings.problem: Bake samples only frames 0 through frameCount-1, retains transform.autoOrient, and its heading reader samples outside the baked range. A valid position expression [frame, frame * frame] changes frame 0 rotation from 0 degrees to 45 degrees after an apparently successful bake with no diagnostics.
findings.fix: Preserve the boundary history/future samples needed by auto-orient or reject cases where bake cannot retain parity.
